name: keploy-a05cabbc-blind30-ots
instr:
# keploy-regen

We moved to a fresh build of the tool we use to capture the traffic an application makes and replay it back later, and a great many small things came back wrong at once. Nothing about the observed applications changed and nothing about the protocols changed. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything we managed to pin down.

Trouble shows up before any traffic moves. Invoked with a settings file on disk and switches typed on the command line, almost every command dies while preparing where its diagnostic output should go, and it dies before noting which switches were actually present, so a value written in the file and a value typed on the command line can no longer be told apart. Putting interception in place outside a container hands back an all-zero v6 address where the v4-mapped loopback ::ffff:127.0.0.1 used to appear, both with v6 interception switched on and with it switched off but an explicit port override supplied; the port in the same answer is right either way. Handing a child process the list of configured side channels through a single environment string fails at both ends: a list holding exactly one channel encodes to the empty string and that channel is silently lost, an empty or absent list, which used to produce nothing at all, now produces a non-empty string, and parsing such a string back fails even on output the encoder beside it just produced.
